fact: On 10 December 2025 the president of the investment company EGS LOITA told the Prime Minister it plans to invest USD 50 million in a new telecommunications company in Equatorial Guinea, with 260 antennas from 2026.
title: EGS LOITA invertirá 50 millones de dólares en la creación de una nueva compañía telefónica en Guinea Ecuatorial
